notes: Home Dojo decorations. Every decoration is earned, never bought. source: starter (Sensei's welcome gifts), tower (found in Tower chests). Later: trophies from real achievements. place: floor or wall (the top wall). solid: the character can't walk through it. clean: mat (gets scuffed, wiped clean) or rack (weapons get knocked crooked, straightened). shape and color are placeholder looks until the art pack.
dropChance_note: Chance that a chest also holds a decoration, by room kind.
